summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its financial results for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026. The report covers operational performance, including gold and copper production, record dividends (final dividend of 750 SA cents), revenue, free cash flow, and strategic updates like the integration of CSA mine and Eva Copper construction. There is no M&A transaction, tender offer, or special-situation event described; it is a routine annual earnings disclosure. The filing does not indicate a board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics, and no risk-arb angle exists. It is classified as a routine current report.
